title: A Primer of the Bolt-Thrower
summary: Teaches a beginner with no qi the stance, loading, sighting and release of the ballista, step by plain step.

title: Winch and Pawl Handbook
summary: Shows a body-only student how the winch, pawl and cord are worked, and how to haul a heavy string safely.

title: The Loader's Workbook
summary: Gives a ballista loader the carrying, seating and calling habits that keep a crew's bolts flowing without accident.

title: Plain Rules of the Trunnion Mount
summary: Explains how to turn, level and steady the ballista on its pivot mount for a body-trained crew member.

title: Drill-Book of the Engine Crew
summary: Drills a three-person ballista crew in moving, planting and firing the engine together on one count.

title: Elementary Treatise on Torsion Arms
summary: Opens the torsion arms of the ballista to a first-circulation student, from reading skein tension to a clean arm whip release.

title: Handbook of the Sighted Bolt
summary: Teaches a Senior-stage shooter to sight along the stock and loose a single bolt true at middle range.

title: A Workbook of Skein and Sinew
summary: Shows how a student with circulating qi tends twisted skeins of sinew and keeps both arms in matched tension.

title: Primer on the Bolt Groove and Release
summary: Covers how the bolt sits in its groove and leaves it, with a light touch of qi on the string.

title: Field Manual of the Pavise Line
